detail.body:
# Overview ![null](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/50317129/138708107-c6f86f3b-e599-4f99-8e61-5371ac7ecbed.png)

OAuth Project

* [OAuth Project](https://project.itcode.dev/oauth2) * [API Specification](https://github.com/RWB0104/api.itcode.dev-oauth2/wiki) * [OAuth Project - Frontend Repository](https://github.com/RWB0104/oauth2) * [OAuth Project - Backend Repository](https://github.com/RWB0104/api.itcode.dev-oauth2) # Demo ![animation](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/50317129/138373743-ca6372cb-4c2e-4517-9190-4babdde6b98a.gif) # Closing Thoughts I've made a lot of things over time, but I never really got around to organizing and documenting them. I wasn't really using GitHub, and I wasn't really running a blog either... And now I've bought a personal server too. This was a project I built as a trial run for my own development portfolio. I think this is the first project I've written up step by step, from development all the way through to wrapping it up. It's nothing special as a project, but I hope it helps someone, somewhere, understand OAuth or build an authorization server.
Developing the project itself didn't take long, but writing it all up into a blog series after studying seems to have actually taken even longer. The date I wrote the first post in this series was the 14th... so it took about 10 days. That works out to a little more than one post a day on average. Somehow it feels like the tail is wagging the dog here...


There's a lot I want to build, and I've got a few things pretty concretely planned out too, but the moment I actually try to start, I just can't be bothered — which is a real problem.
